$comment: Project-shared settings. PostToolUse hook runs the deterministic prd-lint gate whenever a PRD/spec/HLD/brief markdown file is written or edited. On a structural error the hook exits 2, which blocks and feeds the reason back to the agent so it fixes the doc before proceeding. Non-brief files are a silent no-op. This is the 100%-of-the-time layer beneath the prd-interviewer and plan-critic agents.
